title: Playful
description: Playful is a work-in-progress modpack that aims to remove, improve, and overhaul a variety of existing aspects of Minecraft before adding exciting new content. New content includes farming, magic, engineering, and social features.
body:
### A ghiblicore dream... or nightmare?
A ghiblicore dream filled with a farmer's delights, foods, creatures, and magical endeavours. Live out your cosy life in peace or adventure out and explore amongst ruins and unforgettable discoveries. The bravest may seek out the hardest-to-get treasures, while the sane kind of crazies will stick to the engineering of Create or the mind boggling magic from Hex Casting. Find the path in life that _you_ want to take.

### Play with friends!
The pack has a heavy focus on multiplayer gameplay. Most notably, there's proximity voice chat among other more tangible social features.

### Made with love and care
Playful is meant to immerse you and encourage you to engage in mechanics you will likely have neglected—in ways that satisfy and that feel coherent and meaningful. A lot of thought and time goes into this project, so please do report your feedback!

### Work in progress!
This modpack is a work-in-progress. You can find out more about development and planned features on the [project's development page](https://github.com/chrisilly/Playful).
